intro: Convert inches to centimeters (or centimetres) with exact precision for television screens, luggage dimensions, clothing sizes, and workshop blueprints. Under the 1959 international agreement, 1 inch equals exactly 2.54 cm, so multiplying any inch value—decimal or fractional—by 2.54 yields the exact centimeter measurement. Enter whole numbers, decimals like 7.75 in or 33.5 in, or fractions like 1 1/2 in above, or browse the full chart below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact 2.54 Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Inch to Centimeter is 2.54, fixed by the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 in = 2.54 cm).
Approximating 1 inch as 2.5 cm undercounts by ~1.6%—over 10 cm off across 410 inches. Always multiply by 2.54 first.

faqs.question: How many centimeters (cm) are in 1 inch (in)?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 2.54 centimeters (cm) in 1 international inch (in). Conversely, 1 centimeter equals approximately 0.39370079 inches.

faqs.question: How do I convert inches to centimeters (in to cm)?
faqs.answer: To convert inches to centimeters, multiply the inch value by 2.54 (cm = in × 2.54). For example, 37 in × 2.54 = 93.98 cm.

faqs.question: What is 37 inches in centimeters?
faqs.answer: 37 inches (in) equals exactly 93.98 centimeters (centimetres) using the exact 2.54 multiplier.
